_meta.description: Routing profiles control how the smart router balances quality, speed, and cost. Change 'active' to switch profiles. Weights must sum to 1.0.

performance.description: Best possible results. Ignore cost. Use for critical deliverables.

balanced.description: Smart trade-off between quality, speed, and cost. DEFAULT profile.

cost_saver.description: Minimize variable spend. Use cheapest model that can do the job. Auto-activated at 90% budget.

local_only.description: Ollama only. For offline use, emergencies, or privacy-sensitive tasks.
